page.overview:
Who is Yamata no Orochi?

Yamata no Orochi (sometimes spelled Yamatano Orochi) is a titanic dragon/serpent of Japanese mythology. It was first recorded in the Kojiki, an early Japanese chronicle of myths, legends, hymns, genealogies, oral traditions, and semi-historical accounts.

In Marvel Comics, Yamata no Orochi was first mentioned in the comic book issue Black Axe Vol 1 #2, but would not officially appear until Storm Vol 5 #11. In the Marvel Multiverse, Yamata no Orochi is the offspring of the Elder God Set. It was a colossal serpentine dragon with eight heads and eight tails, whose length extended across multiple mountains. The Japanese god Susa-No-O-Izumo slayed the dragon, and afterwards found within its belly, the perfect sword, the Grasscutter.

Yamata no Orochi is also mentioned several times in the Japanese version of the role-playing game Call of Cthulhu.

In The Twilight Angel, a scenario written by Jun Arisaka and published by HobbyJapan, Yamata no Orochi is resurrected from the Pyramid of Lake Shinji by the mastermind Ranko Yūdomari toward the end of the story. Yamata no Orochi is depicted as a ten-headed fiery dragon, and its true form is a massive mass of energy from another dimension. It is approximately 546.8 yards long, and each of its heads can incinerate an area with a diameter of about 0.62 miles using heat rays reaching 18,032°F. While the NPCs Yuri Katagiri and Yūko Katagiri hold it back, the player characters fight Ranko Yūdomari.
